items.title: Morpho Founder's Vault Classification Draws Pushback From Aave's Kulechov
items.summary: Paul Frambot proposed splitting onchain vaults into "noncustodial" and "discretionary" categories for regulators.

items.title: More than $170 million in crypto moves from Bitget wallets to unidentified address
items.summary: The receiving address has made several swaps, but the reason for the Bitget wallet transfers remains unclear.

items.title: Bitget 'Potentially Hacked' as $183 Million Vanishes From Exchange Wallets
items.summary: A newly created wallet drained hot and cold reserves labeled as belonging to Bitget across multiple blockchains in under an hour.

items.title: Bitcoin price steadies, ONDO rallies as US Treasury yields hit 2007 highs
items.summary: US Treasury yields hit a 19-year high on Thursday, pressuring risk assets as Bitcoin held near $84,000 and ONDO became top performer among altcoins.
